parameters.query: SELECT DISTINCT ct.keyword, ct.competitor_domain, ct.competitor_position, ct.our_position, ct.gap FROM competitor_tracking ct WHERE ct.checked_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND (ct.our_position IS NULL OR ct.our_position > 20) AND ct.competitor_position <= 10 ORDER BY ct.gap DESC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

SELECT tk.keyword, kr.position, kr.search_volume FROM tracked_keywords tk JOIN keyword_rankings kr ON kr.keyword_id = tk.id WHERE kr.checked_at = (SELECT MAX(checked_at) FROM keyword_rankings WHERE keyword_id = tk.id) AND tk.is_active = true ORDER BY kr.search_volume DESC NULLS LAST
